advancements.arcanehand.story.level_up.d: Level up an enchantment on your Gauntlet
enchantment.arcanehand.abundance.desc: Mobs and blocks have a chance to drop more loot.
enchantment.arcanehand.blaze.desc: Sets enemies on fire and smelts the drops of blocks.
enchantment.arcanehand.collect.desc: Directly inserts mined blocks into your inventory.
enchantment.arcanehand.excavate.desc: Mine multiple blocks in a radius at once.
enchantment.arcanehand.vein_mining.desc: Breaks matching connected blocks when mining.
enchantment.minecraft.fire_protection.de: Reduces the effects of fire damage and the burn time when on fire.
enchantment.minecraft.blast_protection.d: Reduces damage from explosions and explosion knockback.
enchantment.minecraft.projectile_protect: Reduces damage from projectiles such as arrows and tridents.
enchantment.minecraft.thorns.desc: Causes damage to enemies when they attack you.
enchantment.minecraft.smite.desc: Increases damage against undead mobs such as Zombies and Skeletons.
enchantment.minecraft.bane_of_arthropods: Increases damage against arthropods such as Spiders and Silverfish.
enchantment.minecraft.knockback.desc: Increases the knockback strength of the item.
enchantment.minecraft.efficiency.desc: Increases mining speed of the item.
enchantment.minecraft.silk_touch.desc: Allows fragile blocks such as glass to be collected.
enchantment.minecraft.unbreaking.desc: Causes the item to lose durability at a slower rate.
